name: notemind
description: Chat with your lecture PDFs: answers with page citations, quizzes, and a from-scratch RAG pipeline (heap top-k, FAISS, BM25, hybrid RRF).

paragraphs: Upload lecture PDFs, ask questions, and get answers grounded only in your notes, with a citation such as [lecture3.pdf, p.12] after every claim. If the notes don't contain the answer, NoteMind says "I couldn't find this in your notes." instead of guessing. It also writes multiple-choice quizzes from any page range, and ships with a measured evaluation of its retrieval quality.

The whole retrieval pipeline is written from scratch, without LangChain or LlamaIndex: page-aware PDF ingestion, chunking, a hand-written heap top-k search, FAISS, BM25, and hybrid search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
features: Page-aware PDF ingestion. Text is extracted page by page, so every answer can cite the
exact page. Scanned (image-only) PDFs, empty pages and files that are not real PDFs get clear warnings instead of silent failures.
Configurable chunking (size and overlap), with chunks that never cross a page boundary.
Four retrieval modes, switchable in the UI:
heap: cosine similarity with a hand-written binary min-heap, O(n log k)
